description_en: Clears all face image libraries under a specified business isolation ID on a V-series edge all-in-one device
description_zh: 调用该接口，清空V系列边缘一体机的指定业务隔离ID下所有人脸底库
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual clear-face-device-db --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1Wmy000000 --device-name TestDevice_1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ClearFaceDeviceDB

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is available for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the product to which the device corresponding to the V-series edge all-in-one device belongs. On the **Host Details** page of the V-series edge all-in-one device in the Edge Computing console, click the **Basic Information** tab, find the **Video Gateway** section, and obtain the **ProductKey** value.
